new_candidates.body:
### Describe the bug

Constructing a `@configclass` whose base class defines a read-only `@property` raises
`AttributeError: property '<name>' of '<Child>' object has no setter`.

`_custom_post_init` (source/isaaclab/isaaclab/utils/configclass.py) skips properties when it deep-copies
members, but it looks the member up with `obj.__class__.__dict__.get(key)`, which only sees the instance's
own class. An inherited property is therefore treated as a data member, deep-copied, and assigned back
with `setattr`, which fails for a property without a setter. (An inherited property with a setter has its
setter called on every construction instead.)

This affects shipped configs: the Newton `ContactSensorCfg` defines the read-only alias
`sensor_body_prim_expr`, so any `@configclass` subclass of it cannot be constructed.

### Steps to reproduce

    from isaaclab.utils import configclass
    from isaaclab_newton.sensors.contact_sensor.contact_sensor_cfg import ContactSensorCfg

    @configclass
    class FootContactSensorCfg(ContactSensorCfg):
        history_length: int = 3

    FootContactSensorCfg(prim_path="/World/envs/env_.*/Robot/foot")
    # AttributeError: property 'sensor_body_prim_expr' of 'FootContactSensorCfg' object has no setter

Minimal version without Newton:

    @configclass
    class Parent:
        a: int = 1

        @property
        def double(self) -> int:
            return 2 * self.a

    @configclass
    class Child(Parent):
        b: int = 2

    Child()  # AttributeError: property 'double' of 'Child' object has no setter

### System Info

- Commit: dae8b7991 (main)
- Isaac Sim Version: not needed (config construction only, reproduced without the simulator)
- OS: macOS
- GPU / CUDA / GPU Driver: not needed

### Additional context

Looking the member up through the MRO (`getattr(obj.__class__, key, None)`) fixes it without changing
how fields are copied. I have a one-line fix with a regression test ready and would be glad to open a PR
referencing this issue.

### Checklist

- [x] I have checked that there is no similar issue in the repo (**required**)
- [x] I have checked that the issue is not in running Isaac Sim itself and is related to the repo

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A configclass subclass of a config with a read-only property can be constructed
- [ ] Inherited properties are not treated as fields during post-init copying
